name: gantry
label: Gantry (3P)
description: the simplest 3DOF position tracking robot.  Looking at the position manipulability, there is no hint of a singularity in sight.  The position isotropy shows 1.0, meaning it can move equally well in all directions.

name: shoulder_3r
label: Spherical Shoulder (3R)
description: have seen this in humanoid shoulders quite often for full orientation control via three DOFs with intersecting axes. It is interesting to look at the orientation manipulability, as there is a singularity when the 1st and 3rd DOFs align.
